notes.subject: ⟨a⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew verb הצילני has no explicit subject; Bambara requires it, bracketed

notes.subject: mine eye hath seen his desire
notes.rationale: Hebrew literally 'my eye has looked upon my enemies'; KJV adds 'his desire', JPS 'gazed upon' — rendered here as plain seeing without the added object

notes.subject: tɔɔrɔ
notes.rationale: צרה literally 'tightness/narrowness' as trouble; rendered with the plain Bambara word for affliction

translation: Sabu ⟨a⟩ ye ne bɔ tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ la, ani ne ka ɲɛ ye ne tɛrimɔtɔrɔw ye.
